items.title: 1.1 Tabi'i miqdarein (physical quantities) aur un ke units (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 1.1 with the chapter's opening paragraphs (PDF 4-5).

blocks.text: Physics science ki sab se bunyadi (fundamental) shakh hai. Yeh woh bunyadi usool aur qawaneen (laws) deti hai jin se science ki doosri shakhon, jaise astronomy, chemistry, geology, biology aur health sciences, ke raaz samajh aate hain. Physics ke auzaar (tools), techniques aur products ne hamare khwabon ko haqeeqat bana diya hai. Hamari zindagi mein jo aaram aur sahooliyat aayi hai woh rozmarra zindagi mein science, technology aur engineering ka phal hai.

Information technology ne insaan ki soch ka andaaz bilkul badal diya hai. Tez rabte ke zariyon (communication) ne poori duniya ke logon ko itna qareeb kar diya hai ke saari duniya ek global village (aalmi gaaon) ban gayi hai.
Computer chips silicon se bante hain, aur silicon ret (sand) se milta hai. Yeh hum par hai ke ret se ret ka qila banayein ya computer.
blocks.title: Think over! (Sochiye!)

blocks.text: Physics ek experimental (tajurbati) science hai, aur scientific method is baat par zor deta hai ke napi ja sakne wali physical quantities ki durust (accurate) paimaish (measurement) ki jaye. Yeh chapter napne ki techniques aur readings record karne ki maharat samjhane par zor deta hai.

Physics ki bunyad physical quantities par hai; physics ke qawaneen inhi quantities mein likhe jate hain. Is liye in quantities ko durust napna zaroori hai. Misal: mass, length, time, velocity, force, density, temperature, electric current aur bohat si doosri.

Physical quantities aam taur par do qismon mein banti hain: base quantities aur derived quantities. Derived quantities woh hain jo base quantities par munhasir (depend) hain, maslan velocity, acceleration, force waghaira. Base quantities kisi doosri physical quantity ke zariye define nahi hotin. Yeh azaad (independent) quantities hain jin ke zariye baqi sab physical quantities define ki ja sakti hain. Aam misalein: length, mass aur time.

Kisi base quantity ki paimaish mein do qadam hain: pehla, ek standard (mayaar) chunna; doosra, napi jane wali quantity ko us standard se milane ka tareeqa tay karna, taake us quantity ki paimaish ek adad (number) aur ek unit ki shakal mein mil jaye.
Paimaishein qabil-e-bharosa (reliable) aur durust honi chahiye taake unhen aasani se aur sahi tarah istemal kiya ja sake.

blocks.caption: Physical quantity ki do qismein
rows: azaad; doosri quantities ke zariye bayan nahi

blocks.prompt: Kya density base quantity hai ya derived, aur base quantity napne mein kaun se do qadam hain?
blocks.explanation: Density derived quantity hai: density = mass / volume, aur volume khud length se banta hai. Base quantity napne ke do qadam: (1) ek standard chunna, (2) napi jane wali quantity ko us standard se milane ka tareeqa tay karna, jis se ek adad aur ek unit milta hai.

items: Physics experimental science hai; us ke qawaneen physical quantities mein likhe jate hain, is liye inhen durust napna zaroori hai.
Base quantities (length, mass, time) azaad hain; derived quantities (velocity, acceleration, force) un par munhasir hain.
Base quantity ki paimaish: standard chunein, phir milane ka tareeqa tay karein; nateeja = adad + unit.
